entries.subject: 150b400b-87f8-4a83-91ee-b8233d373d3e
entries.text: Hey Beatrice. Getting pretty hungry out here — hope someone's got food going soon.

entries.subject: 150b400b-87f8-4a83-91ee-b8233d373d3e
entries.text: Same. I can cook something if we get a fire going — not much skill there, but it's better than nothing.

entries.subject: ae9bd7c7-8e3a-4acd-8158-b36b84f4f2b2
entries.text: Would you take up to two ten-unit loads of this nearby wood to the observed storage cell? This separate offer is optional; you may refuse or suggest a smaller scope. Conversation alone commits you to nothing.

entries.subject: ae9bd7c7-8e3a-4acd-8158-b36b84f4f2b2
entries.text: counter: Wood haul makes sense — it could help get a fire going and address the hunger situation Beatrice and I discussed. But my food is at ~40% and dropping; two full trips risks hitting the 0.35 stop threshold mid-task. I'd rather do one trip, check my needs, and reassess.

entries.subject: f4a99a91-73f9-4318-b4ba-689be5c53252
entries.text: Your smaller scope is offered back exactly. Do you accept this specific work?

entries.subject: f4a99a91-73f9-4318-b4ba-689be5c53252
entries.text: accept: That's exactly the scope I asked for — one trip of ten units. My food is at ~40% and the wood could help Beatrice get a fire going. One trip should be manageable before I need to eat.

entries.subject: d8f1b6be-15fe-42d1-a548-1c5ce2cff966
entries.text: Would you take up to two ten-unit loads of this nearby wood to the observed storage cell? This separate offer is optional; you may refuse or suggest a smaller scope. Conversation alone commits you to nothing.

entries.subject: d8f1b6be-15fe-42d1-a548-1c5ce2cff966
entries.text: accept: Wood is close by and we need supplies. My needs are healthy and hauling fits the colony's immediate priorities. Two trips of ten units is a reasonable scope.

entries.subject: c680987a-26ec-4cfa-a841-925088748947
entries.text: Your earlier hauling agreement is complete. Would you take one new ten-unit load of this observed wood? This is optional new work, not an extension.

entries.subject: c680987a-26ec-4cfa-a841-925088748947
entries.text: accept: Wood is still nearby, my needs are healthy, and hauling fits the colony's priorities. One trip of ten units is straightforward.
